references.text: Joshua and the entire army prepare to march up against Ai, which is the same preparation described here.
The first failed attack on Ai, providing context for why this second strategy involving an ambush was used.
Describes how the army was positioned with the main force north of the city and the ambush west of the city, the same strategic setup.
Israel uses a similar ambush tactic against Gibeah, where they position forces around the city.
The Israelite camp before the plains of Moab, showing a similar pattern of camping before a military operation.
The conquest of Jericho, where the entire army also participated in a strategic military operation.
